decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housing has a dedicated page and stable technical fit, so its option value justifies keeping it while uncertainty remains.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's strategic direction and gained its own page, making it a high-value option to keep.
Despite reduced visibility, the designer shower drainage product is still aligned with the design-led direction and flagship status, so it remains worth keeping.
The integrated-slope shower element supports the core shower-system range but has only been mentioned, so it is a lower-commitment option that could be pruned if it fails to gain traction.
The backflow-protected basement floor drain has shown strong website visibility and addresses a distinct niche, so its option value remains high enough to keep.
The air-admittance valve is peripheral to the core drainage systems and was only mentioned, indicating low option value that no longer justifies continued resource commitment.
